not_completed: No combined-condition qualification, preparation, capture, policy inference, or MuJoCo stepping was performed; these are outside this review-only task scope.

observations.text: The sealed source 1.0 m/s reference, its repeat, and the shared-adapter case are all PASS with the same recorded trace digest; the reported mean body-forward speed is 0.938050 m/s.
The prior model-only and shared-home-only 1.0 m/s cases are both PASS under the frozen source gates.
Relevant counterevidence remains sealed: first-inference-only at 1.0 m/s failed the lateral gate; 0.15 and 0.30 m/s cases failed performance gates; the stairs case stopped on base contact.
The copied source capture and verification bundles match their sealed manifests; offline verification reports ten attempts, no errors, and zero physics steps.
The combination protocol binds two attempts, an exact repeat of combined_1 as combined_2, a first-pass dependency, no retries, and first-nonpass stopping.
The new protocol uses the same reference, tracking, lateral, yaw, and safety gate values as the sealed source protocol, and the task binds its exact protocol hash.

inferences.text: The full shared-model, shared-home, and adapter interaction is the minimal unresolved deployment question because the source reference and each relevant single-factor condition are already characterized, while the combination is absent from prior cases.
The thresholds are prospective for this campaign: they match the pre-existing source gates, are frozen in the task-bound protocol, and no combined-condition outcome was used to set them.
The second case is appropriate for bounded deterministic repeatability checking, but two identical traces cannot estimate independent success probability.

Changing model, home, and adapter together prevents component-level causal attribution; because the target is the complete pinned deployment and the task disclaims such attribution, this is not a vetoing confound.

conclusions.text: The frozen experiment is scientifically valid to run within its stated scope; the science review verdict is APPROVED for target head a31fe64afd6b7669765fa83137d70ab6dad11c75.

Any later interpretation must remain limited to the complete pinned combination under the deterministic flat 1.0 m/s setup; this review does not report an empirical combined-condition result or independently authorize execution.

uncertainty.text: No empirical outcome for the combined condition was generated in this review-only task; whether that condition meets the frozen gates remains unknown.

The repeat requirement does not establish a success probability, statistical reliability, causal attribution, low-speed behavior, terrain robustness, hardware transfer, or other-checkpoint performance.
